written_by_hand: This run was made on a node that holds no copy of the repository, so record_run.py could not record it. The manifest is assembled here from what the node returned; node.json is the node's own account of its environment and its cells, and score.log is its console output.
host: Apple M4 Pro laptop, 24 GB unified memory, macOS 26.6.2, the machine of experiments/2026-09-04-m4pro-tabpfn-timing
gpu: Apple Silicon GPU (arm64), Metal via torch 2.14.0 MPS, memory shared with the system
command: bash run.sh from the job archive, which run-score.sh expanded to: python score_context.py 2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle --out-dir 2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle-scored --models tabpfn --nearest 3 --seeds 20260911

job_archive.score_context_py_provenance: LF-normalised hash of the copy inside the archive; equal to scripts/score_context.py in this tree, unchanged since commit 6ff4872. The node copies the script with CR bytes stripped and does not re-hash it, so the identity of what ran rests on the archive rather than on a check made there.

result_archive.name: outoftime-result-2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle.tar.gz
result_archive.contents: 2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle-scored/ (node.json, scores.parquet, reference.parquet, parts/) and score.log, copied here unchanged

bundle_check.how: The hashes the node recorded in node.json for the bundle it read, equal to the files of experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle on this machine. The scorer refuses a bundle whose hashes differ from bundle.json, so the node scored the recorded rows.

row_check.scored: 60,000 rows over 2015Q3, 2015Q4, 2016Q1; every (cohort, row) pair and its outcome and age match the gbm rows of experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-scores/scores.parquet, zero mismatches
row_check.reference: 50,000 rows; every row and its outcome match the gbm-50k reference of context seed 20260911 in experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-scores/reference.parquet, zero mismatches

console_log: score.log is included. It is ten lines of the scorer's own summary; it was read in full and holds no home path, no account name and no token.
question_this_run_was_sent_to_answer: The TabPFN side of the cheapest falsifying run of EXP-002: one build (2015H1-E), one context seed, the three cohorts nearest the build date, so that the paired intervals of experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-intervals2 can be read against a foundation model on the same rows.

what_it_measured.model: tabpfn 8.5.0, checkpoint tabpfn-v3-classifier-v3_default.ckpt (sha256 d0d865d5...3988), tabicl 2.1.1 present and not used
what_it_measured.context: 50,000 rows of seed 20260911, categorical_features_indices [6, 13, 19], ignore_pretraining_limits true, every other parameter at its default (node.json)
what_it_measured.repeat: 2015Q3 scored twice from a fresh fit: largest absolute disagreement 0.0, no row differs

tuning_budget: Added 2026-09-06 after the seventh cold audit, which found the baseline gate's budget statement missing from the run manifests. TabPFN: zero trials, no validation split, every parameter at the library default except categorical_features_indices and ignore_pretraining_limits (node.json params); n_estimators is 'auto' and the realised ensemble size is not recorded. The classical models it is paired with were tuned on their own pool (build.json of experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-scores), and the asymmetry runs both ways: the foundation model gets no tuning, the 50,000-row control inherits the point chosen on the 323,026-row pool.
against_the_timing_run: experiments/2026-09-04-m4pro-tabpfn-timing measured 319.5 s for 20,000 scored rows at a 50,000 context; the three cohort cells here took 313.6 to 320.3 s.
not_in_this_run: TabICL. It does not fit a 24 GB Apple machine at a 10,000-row context (the timing run's manifest); its side of the falsifying run is scored on a CUDA node from the same bundle with --models tabicl.
